title: Check: Pollination and Fertilisation in Plants

options.text: The growth of a pollen tube through the style
The transfer of pollen from an anther to a stigma
The fusion of male and female gametes
The development of a seed from an ovule

questions.explanation: Pollination is the transfer of pollen grains from the anther of one flower to the stigma of another flower (cross-pollination) or the same flower (self-pollination). It is not the same as fertilisation.
